title.rendered: Your Customers Are on Amazon. Now Your Ads Can Be Too.

content.rendered:
Amazon Ads Explained: Prime Video, Connected TV, and Retail Media

Marketing budgets are shifting, and one category is growing faster than almost any other: retail media. It is advertising built around the places people actually shop and stream, and Amazon sits right at the centre of it. For brands in Vancouver, Calgary, and Toronto, Amazon Ads open a rare chance to reach engaged audiences with the storytelling power of television and the accountability of digital, all from one platform.

Amazon is no longer only a marketplace. It is where people research products, compare their options, stream their favourite shows on Prime Video, and make everyday buying decisions. Advertising there means meeting customers inside habits they already have, instead of interrupting them somewhere they would rather not be.

What Are Amazon Ads?

Amazon Ads are a suite of advertising solutions spanning streaming, display, and shopping placements. The most common misconception: Amazon Ads are only for sellers fighting over product listings. In reality, product listings are a small slice of a much larger toolkit. The platform can introduce your brand to new audiences on Prime Video, keep you visible while shoppers weigh their choices, and drive measurable action when they are ready to buy. In short, Amazon Ads cover the full funnel, from awareness through consideration to conversion, in one connected ecosystem.

Streaming Ads

Why Retail Media Is Growing So Fast

Retail media is now one of the fastest-expanding channels in all of advertising, and the reason is simple. Traditional targeting has become harder as privacy rules tighten and third-party cookies fade. Amazon offers something rare in response: audiences defined by real shopping behaviour rather than guesswork. For a marketer, this shift means less waste and more relevance. You reach people already signalling intent, and you do it inside a trusted environment they visit every single day.

Amazon Prime Video and Connected TV Advertising

Streaming has reshaped how audiences watch, and connected TV advertising lets your brand appear on the big screen without buying blanket linear television. Through Amazon Ads, you can run campaigns inside Prime Video, a premium environment where viewers are settled in and paying attention. The payoff is the best of both worlds: cinematic reach to build recall, paired with clear reporting on outcomes like site visits and conversions.

For many of our clients, connected TV becomes the connective tissue between brand building and performance marketing. It is also a smart hedge when paid search or social has been carrying the entire load, because it adds fresh reach, strengthens recall, and improves overall campaign efficiency.

Web Development

Amazon Display Advertising Across the Journey

Amazon display advertising reaches well beyond a single page or moment. It can meet people as they browse Amazon and, in many cases, across a wider web of placements. Use it to make a strong first impression, keep a timely offer in front of the right audience, or bring back shoppers who looked but did not buy.

For local brands, this is where precision pays off. You stop buying raw impressions and start building a steady presence, and a steady presence is usually what turns curiosity into quality leads and repeat customers.

eCommerce Advertising: Closing the Loop

If you sell online, or realistically could, Amazon shortens the distance between discovery and purchase. Shoppers arrive with intent, and the platform is built around it. Even brands who do not see themselves as Amazon-first can use it to shape decisions and drive measurable outcomes. The trick is matching the strategy to your funnel, your margins, and your growth goals, so every dollar has a clear job to do.

The Data Advantage: Amazon’s Shopping Signals

Here is what sets Amazon apart from most media. Its targeting draws on real shopping behaviour, not assumptions. This depth of first-party insight means your budget reaches people with real buying intent, which lifts efficiency across the entire campaign. Better still, the learnings do not stay locked inside Amazon. The intent signals you gather can sharpen how you plan search, social, and connected TV everywhere else in your mix.

How Amazon Ads Fit a Canadian Media Mix

Amazon Ads are not a replacement for the marketing you already trust. They are an amplifier. A garden centre in Vancouver can pair Prime Video reach with local search. A retailer in Calgary can retarget site visitors through Amazon display while running radio and outdoor. A professional services firm in Toronto can layer connected TV over its LinkedIn and Google Ads. The strongest results almost always come from an integrated plan where each channel reinforces the others, and Amazon slots neatly into that approach.

Kosick Is an Amazon Ads Partner

As a certified Amazon Ads Partner, Kosick Communications gives clients direct access to Prime Video connected TV, display, and eCommerce advertising inside one performance-driven ecosystem. More valuable still, we help you decide where Amazon actually fits alongside the search, social, TV, and outdoor you already run, what results to expect, and how to build a plan worth the investment.

If retail media is not part of your strategy yet, now is the moment to explore it.

Frequently Asked Questions About Amazon Ads

What are Amazon Ads? Amazon Ads are a family of advertising solutions covering streaming video on Prime Video, display placements on and off Amazon, and eCommerce ads tied to shopping. Together they let a brand build awareness, guide consideration, and drive conversions from a single platform.

Can Canadian businesses advertise on Amazon Prime Video? Yes. Brands across Canada, including Vancouver, Calgary, and Toronto, can run connected TV campaigns inside Prime Video through Amazon Ads. Working with an Amazon Ads Partner like Kosick makes access and setup simpler.

Do Amazon Ads only work for products sold on Amazon? No. While Amazon Ads are excellent for products listed on Amazon, display and Prime Video campaigns can promote almost any brand, service, or website. Even businesses who never sell on Amazon use its audiences to reach ready-to-buy customers.

How much do Amazon Ads cost? Budgets are flexible and depend on your goals, chosen formats, and audience. Connected TV, display, and eCommerce ads each carry different costs, so the smartest approach is a plan matched to your funnel and margins rather than a fixed spend.

What is an Amazon Ads Partner? An Amazon Ads Partner is an agency recognized by Amazon for its expertise in planning and running these campaigns. As a partner, Kosick helps clients access Prime Video, display, and eCommerce inventory and build strategies designed for measurable growth.
